Why they are kept here
  This turn is the second shape of the same misreading. The evidence record
  says the separate test run was skipped on purpose (signal_absent = false,
  test_command = "skipped", tests_required = false) and the coach rejected the
  turn over exactly that. What makes turn 3 different from the TASK-44A8-004
  turn 1 beside it is what stands next to the false objection: six
  deterministic honesty records of type claim_audit_unmodified, each at
  severity should_fix — warnings that, by guardkit's own reconciler
  (coach_narrative_reconciler.py), never reject a turn.

  The saved decision file shows those six records already embedded ahead of the
  coach's own objection, because the file on disk was written after the
  narrative reconciler ran. Live, the guard runs before that step, so it sees
  the coach's objection alone. The tests built on these files cover both
  orders, so the guard gives the same answer either way.

No secrets: both files were scanned for API keys, passwords, tokens and
message-broker or database connection strings before they were copied (zero
matches).
